lead_independence.headline: Two Miami Women Charged After Tow Yard Shooting Near Stuart Sparks School Lockout
lead_independence.lead: Two Miami women are facing charges following a shooting Friday afternoon at a tow yard near Stuart that triggered a lockout at a nearby middle school and ended with a crash and a PIT maneuver by Martin County deputies, according to the Martin County Sheriff's Office. Jade Ely Brandon, 23, is charged with two counts of aggravated assault with a firearm, discharging a firearm in public, aggravated fleeing and eluding, driving while license suspended and felony criminal mischief. Sheriff John Budensiek said Valerie Valdes, 22, caused a crash while fleeing the scene and faces charges of operating an unregistered motorcycle vehicle and reckless driving with injuries.

source_focus.source_title: Altercation at tow yard leads to shooting, Martin County Sheriff's Office says - WPBF
source_focus.source_lead: Two women are in custody in Martin County after a shooting at a tow yard in Stuart led to a police chase and a violent crash. “I have more questions than I have answers,” said Martin County Sheriff John Budensiek. Budensiek said the incident began around 1 p.m. when two women arrived at the tow yard to retrieve a car that had been towed earlier that morning.
